description:
Patch the base OS (apt upgrade), install base deps (PostgreSQL, nginx,
    wkhtmltopdf, fail2ban…), create the odoo PG role, make the /opt/odoo dirs, jail
    sshd against brute-force, and (optionally) open the host firewall. Idempotent.

    system_upgrade: True (default) runs `apt upgrade` FIRST - a fresh cloud image is
    usually weeks behind on security fixes, so we patch it before installing anything
    (unattended-safe: keeps existing config files, no dpkg prompts). If it pulls a new
    kernel/libc the result carries `reboot_required=yes` - reboot the box before go-live
    (we don't reboot mid-provision, it would drop ssh). Set False to skip patching.

    host_firewall: True (default) enables a host UFW for 22/80/443 as defense-in-
    depth. Set False when you manage the firewall at the VPS provider (your provider's
    cloud firewall) and don't want a second firewall on the box - fail2ban is
    installed either way.
name: base_provision
